boundary_policy: backward differences within 8 raw frames; unknown neighbor velocity excludes motion packet at steps1..7; initial position-only social init allowed at step0; ego first acceleration is an explicit zero-acceleration boundary prior with validity=False
posterior_policy: unchanged official VAE and loss; y used only by supervised posterior/loss; neighbor future slots all padding constructed from history, never future-neighbor GT

resource_benchmark.selection: fixed seed17 random training target permutation; includes naturally occurring padded context sizes, plus maximum-neighbor batch forward/backward check

smoke.batch_fallback: largest successful predeclared batch among128/64/32/16; single fixed choice after resource-only checks
smoke.best_rule: minimum validation K1 latent-prior-mean ADE; exact tie earliest epoch; paired FDE; last5 separate
smoke.epoch_definition: one shuffled pass over every supervised training target; no resampling cap
smoke.evaluation: entire frozen validation target set each epoch; no FPC; K20 sampling seed171000+batch_index; diagnostic posterior seed172000+batch_index
smoke.loss: unchanged official reconstruction mean + Monte Carlo latent KL mean
smoke.stop: first nonfinite loss/gradient/output stops run; no LR search or automatic retry; no extension

split_policy: Stage3.5 exact train/validation window support; train only old train regions on other recordings; no old validation promoted to train; held-recording original train excluded
units: official neural interface: displacements m/step and differences m/step^2; physical derivatives divide by dt and dt^2 only for diagnostics/CV
